mapper.select: SELECT item_id, watchlist_id, instrument_id, display_order, added_at, alert_price, alert_direction FROM Watchlist_Items WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} ORDER BY display_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Watchlist_Items (item_id, watchlist_id, instrument_id, display_order, added_at, alert_price, alert_direction) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{watchlistId}, #{instrumentId}, #{displayOrder}, #{addedAt}, #{alertPrice}, #{alertDirection})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM Watchlist_Items WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} AND instrument_id = #{instrumentId}
